(~M ⊃ ~N) ∨ (O ≡ N) and (~M · N) · [(~O ∨ ~N) · (O ∨ N)]

A. Logically equivalent
B. Contradictory
C. Neither logically equivalent nor contradictory, but consistent
D. Inconsistent

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
